nominal_case: original ANDES Kundur full, all original background network/device parameters retained; demonstration events disabled
balancing: original slack power-flow balancing only, no altered PV dispatch or manual redistribution; report slack before/after and initialized generator values
contracts: dynamic optional amplitudes in [0,a] with common block sign

support_settings.double_phase_grid_when: largest relative analytic interpolation error committed >2%; max16384
support_settings.phase: minimum of global derivative bound and sampled derivative + derivative tail + half-grid*global second derivative, multiplied by half-grid
support_settings.numeric_scope: formula-based conditional floating point LTI bounds, no directed-rounding certificate

replay_selection_before_outcomes.physical_cap: total amplitude <=100MW and each port <=50MW; mark any clipped margin as not an uncapped outside test
replay_selection_before_outcomes.reset_false_admission: 0.98*min(reset_inner_capacity,100 MW); replay proper committed maximizing all-history finite word at that amplitude, compare proper boundary
replay_selection_before_outcomes.finite_word: 256 history blocks plus final current block, original nonlinear grid starts at equilibrium at t=0; start forcing at t=1, quarter-block switches, stop after full final block, add20s ringdown
replay_selection_before_outcomes.refinement_cases: dynamic margin pair and reset false-admission case

qualification.derivative_checks: central differences of original DAE residual wrt P ports and mixed x/y directions, plus small P-pulse nonlinear versus new linear descriptor

affine_work_law: Only under w_i(t)=wbar_i+kappa_i*deltaP_i(t), wbar_i>=abs(kappa_i)*a_i; each exact zero-area full block has unchanged incremental energy/work. No empirical compute-power validation or real workload claim.
